statusDetail: Audit stopped during mandatory recon because Akamai edge protection returned HTTP 403 Access Denied to both Chrome CDP navigation and a direct HTTP request, exposing only a 374-byte error document instead of ESPNcricinfo content.

page.notes: The origin response was replaced by an Akamai Access Denied page; site architecture and representative templates could not be determined.

artifacts.caption: Atomic 58-check coverage manifest and per-check evidence plan.
Desktop entry navigation shows the Akamai Access Denied response.
Rendered DOM is a minimal Access Denied error document.
Raw and rendered requests both returned the 403 error document.
Crawler-view screenshot of the same 403 response.
Recon probe: Access Denied title/H1 and no navigable links.
Direct HTTP response headers confirm HTTP 403 from AkamaiGHost.
SHA-256 checksum of the exact principles catalog used.
